Nice to Have Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Experience in implementation and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) environment, especially Field Services. Previous hands-on experience in software engineering, application development or a related technical field. Technical background in application development Experience with ServiceNow and Azure DevOps ITIL4 Certification Why SGS? Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry. Enjoy a flexible schedule and hybrid work model Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus. Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents. Benefit from a comprehensive benefits platform.
